evidence.title: ShipVoice: the voice AI platform agencies own

name: ShipVoice
summary: LiveKit voice-agent boilerplate with Stripe per-minute metered billing, telephony, a call console and one-command deploy.
description: A self-hostable platform for building and billing voice-AI products on LiveKit: meter STT, LLM, TTS and telephony per minute, add your margin, and charge end users through your own Stripe. It ships auth, telephony, a client console with calls, transcripts and spend, ten call patterns, and swappable provider plugins (LiveKit Cloud, Deepgram, OpenAI, Cartesia, ElevenLabs, Twilio, Telnyx). The kernel is open source (MIT); the agency edition is a one-time commercial license.
contains: MIT-licensed LiveKit voice core (livekit-starter) plus a paid agency edition
per-minute Stripe metered billing across STT, LLM, TTS and telephony, with your margin
auth, telephony and a call dashboard
ten call patterns: solo, supervisor, relay, guided path, observer, talker & thinker, background worker
plugin slots: LiveKit Cloud or self-hosted, Deepgram, OpenAI, Cartesia, ElevenLabs, Twilio, Telnyx
client console with calls, transcripts and spend
free guides: 18-chapter Voice AI primer, margin calculator, platform comparison, 10DLC guide
founding access $199 one-time for the first 50, then $299 at launch (2 Sept 2026)
